name: KRU on Mt. Meigs
description: KRU is a vibrant karaoke venue known for its welcoming atmosphere and diverse crowd. It offers a relaxed environment with a focus on community and artistic expression, featuring live DJ nights and a variety of entertainment options. The venue emphasizes a friendly vibe, excellent drinks, and a space that celebrates local artists and inclusive culture, making it a favorite spot for both casual and dedicated karaoke enthusiasts.
